name: Anichin Providers
description: Nuvio streaming providers for donghua: Anichin, Animexin, DonghuaKing (Bilibili and Odysee included but disabled).
author: zeeelanddd-pixel

scrapers.name: Anichin
scrapers.description: Anichin provider for publicly accessible video pages.
scrapers.author: zeeelanddd-pixel

scrapers.name: Animexin
scrapers.description: Animexin provider for publicly accessible donghua mirrors (Indonesian and English subtitles).
scrapers.author: zeeelanddd-pixel

scrapers.name: DonghuaKing
scrapers.description: DonghuaKing provider for publicly accessible donghua mirrors (Indonesian and English subtitles).
scrapers.author: zeeelanddd-pixel

scrapers.name: Bilibili
scrapers.description: Disabled by default: Bilibili blocks anonymous API requests (HTTP 412) and rarely carries Indonesian subtitles. Public Bilibili API provider.
scrapers.author: zeeelanddd-pixel

scrapers.name: Odysee
scrapers.description: Disabled by default: only returns claims with a verifiable reusable license (CC0, Public Domain, CC BY / BY-SA), which donghua almost never have.
scrapers.author: zeeelanddd-pixel
